item.title: Assistant Superintendent Of The Year!
item.description: Chillicothe R-II School District Assistant Superintendent Dr. Brian Sherrow was named the Northwest Missouri Association of Administrators Assistant Superintendent of the Year! Superintendent Dr Dan Wiebers spoke about the recognition. Says he has many responsibilities. He’ll be recognized in March at the MASA State Conference.
